Current configuration:
!
frr version 10.2.1_git
frr defaults traditional
hostname r4
domainname localdomain
log syslog informational
!
ip prefix-list PL-EBGP-OUT seq 10 permit 10.2.0.0/16
ip prefix-list PL-EBGP-OUT seq 20 permit 192.168.2.0/24
ip prefix-list PL-EBGP-IN seq 10 permit 10.1.0.0/16
ip prefix-list PL-EBGP-IN seq 20 permit 192.168.1.0/24
!
ipv6 prefix-list PL6-EBGP-OUT seq 10 permit 2001:db8:2::/48
ipv6 prefix-list PL6-EBGP-OUT seq 20 permit 2001:db8:a2::/64
ipv6 prefix-list PL6-EBGP-IN seq 10 permit 2001:db8:1::/48
ipv6 prefix-list PL6-EBGP-IN seq 20 permit 2001:db8:a1::/64
!
ip route 10.2.0.0/16 Null0
ipv6 route 2001:db8:2::/48 Null0
!
interface eth1
 description eBGP-vers-r3-AS65001
 ip address 172.16.34.2/30
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf passive
 ipv6 address 2001:db8:34::3/127
 ipv6 ospf6 area 0
 ipv6 ospf6 passive
exit
!
interface eth2
 description vers-r5
 ip address 10.2.45.1/30
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf authentication message-digest
 ip ospf message-digest-key 1 md5 lab-ospf-r4r5
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ipv6 address 2001:db8:2:45::2/127
 ipv6 ospf6 area 0
 ipv6 ospf6 network point-to-point
exit
!
interface lo
 ip address 10.2.255.4/32
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf passive
 ipv6 address 2001:db8:2:ff::4/128
 ipv6 ospf6 area 0
 ipv6 ospf6 passive
exit
!
router bgp 65002
 bgp router-id 10.2.255.4
 neighbor 172.16.34.1 remote-as 65001
 neighbor 172.16.34.1 description r3-AS65001
 neighbor 172.16.34.1 password lab-bgp-r3r4
 neighbor 172.16.34.1 ttl-security hops 1
 neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 remote-as 65001
 neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 description r3-AS65001-v6
 neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 password lab-bgp-v6r3r4
 neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 ttl-security hops 1
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.2.0.0/16
  network 192.168.2.0/24
  neighbor 172.16.34.1 maximum-prefix 10
  neighbor 172.16.34.1 route-map RM-EBGP-IN in
  neighbor 172.16.34.1 route-map RM-EBGP-OUT out
  no neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 activate
 exit-address-family
 !
 address-family ipv6 unicast
  network 2001:db8:2::/48
  network 2001:db8:a2::/64
  neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 activate
  neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 maximum-prefix 10
  neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 route-map RM6-EBGP-IN in
  neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 route-map RM6-EBGP-OUT out
 exit-address-family
exit
!
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.2.255.4
 redistribute bgp
exit
!
router ospf6
 ospf6 router-id 10.2.255.4
 redistribute bgp
exit
!
route-map RM-EBGP-IN permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-EBGP-IN
exit
!
route-map RM-EBGP-OUT permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-EBGP-OUT
exit
!
route-map RM6-EBGP-IN permit 10
 match ipv6 address prefix-list PL6-EBGP-IN
exit
!
route-map RM6-EBGP-OUT permit 10
 match ipv6 address prefix-list PL6-EBGP-OUT
exit
!
